error[VIBE1124]: The element `<template>` has no end tag.
  --> html/eof-in-tag/input.vibe:1:1
1 | <template>
  | ^^^^^^^^^^
fix: Add `</template>` where the element ends.
fix: Write `<template />` for an element without content.
docs: https://vibejs.org/v0/errors/VIBE1124

error[VIBE1109]: The file ends inside a tag that has no `>`.
  --> html/eof-in-tag/input.vibe:2:21
2 |   <div class="a" id=
  |                     ^
fix: Close the tag with `>`.
fix: Close the quote of the last attribute value.
docs: https://vibejs.org/v0/errors/VIBE1109
